title: Cash on delivery confirmation
description: An online store selling handloom sarees and dress material across India.
main_task:
Confirm every cash on delivery order before we dispatch it.
1. Confirm the item they ordered and the amount to pay in cash on delivery.
2. Confirm the delivery address and pin code.
3. Tell them delivery takes 4 to 6 days.
4. If they no longer want it, cancel the order.
